title: Membership Switching Walkthrough
summary: Explain the feature workflow and gather comment-only clarification.
freshSessionContext: Staff need to understand how membership switching handles overlapping dates and manual financial work.

blocks.title: Story
blocks.body: Staff selects a new membership, reviews collision warnings, then confirms replacement when date semantics permit it.

items.title: Same-day replacement
items.body: Blocked because memberships are active through the end date.
